title: Figure 31. LLV1 Simulation Results with Best-Fit Shaping Constants
description: Semi-log line graph titled "LLV1 Random-Attitude Failures through 290 sec" plotting Percent in 5-deg sector (%) versus Angle From Flight Path (deg), 0–180. Simulated impacts for no breakup and q-alpha 20,000/10,000/5,000 are compared with theoretical curves for A = 2.45, B = 10,000; A = 2.60, B = 1,000; A = 2.70, B = 1,000; and A = 2.75, B = 1,000. Text notes a good fit for the no-breakup case is possible with higher B and A values. Captioned "Figure 31. LLV1 Simulation Results with Best-Fit Shaping Constants".
